tools.description: Find general occupation profiles from skills, interests or a named role, then rank the bounded candidates locally with BGE.
tools.output: Occupations, tasks, expected skills and stored Australian mappings. No personal suitability score.

tools.description: Retrieve public Australian job advertisement records by role/skill and the user's resolved area.
tools.output: Dated advertisements with geographic scope, source links and sample-only structured skill counts. Current availability is not established.

tools.description: Find qualifications and course records linked to requested skills or units.
tools.output: Stored skill/unit links and course IDs for exploration; no claim of assessed user competence or guaranteed provider delivery.

tools.description: Use the comparison snippet to separate shared national qualification content, recorded RTO delivery/support differences and Yuzee-created course intelligence.
tools.output: A bounded evidence-linked comparison; no arbitrary provider ranking or invented curriculum difference.

tools.description: Introduce the user's resolved area, community places, dated job/employer records and longer-term outlook before interest exploration.
tools.output: Area-scoped overview and public directory examples; dated occupation demand and forecast context. Counts are not all local companies or confirmed open vacancies.

responsibilities.Gemini: Interpret the current request; plan bounded retrieval; explain results and uncertainties.
responsibilities.BGE: Retrieve activity candidates and locally rank occupation candidates. Similarity is not confidence or permission.
responsibilities.application: Own SQL, record projections, source IDs, geography, persistence and interactive controls.
responsibilities.user: Choose roles, report experience, mark learning interests and correct the area.

save_scope: Conversation only; no writes to the source warehouse or external profile.
